duck.scope: Music bus after production duck gain, synchronous with post-master reference. Total mix contains engine/launch and is not a music-gain measurement.

postMasterLaunch.method: 50 ms 20–200 Hz differential event waveform matched to post-master PCM; three consecutive windows require correlation >0.5 and projected RMS >0.003. Mixer latency calibrated by 0–20 ms lag scan at 1 ms spacing. This confirms routing, not perceived loudness.
